scope: Projects and explicit exceptions for the root octane-tsc typecheck. Every published package's tsconfig.json and .tsrx-aware typecheck projects must be reached, or listed here with a reason and an expiry date.

materializedProjects.reason: Compiles the upstream @floating-ui/react type tests that the React parity harness materializes into packages/floating-ui/tests/upstream/, which is gitignored, so a clean checkout has no inputs. The parity lane typechecks it after materializing.
